The `encryption` package and pipeline integration have been implemented and committed on the `feature/encryption` branch:

- **[encryption/encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go)**:
  - Implemented [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go#L38-L59) validating 32-byte keys (wrapping `ErrInvalidKey`).
  - Implemented [`EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go#L70-L77) for streaming AES-256-GCM encryption in up to 64KB chunks with header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), 4-byte big-endian chunk length prefix, unique 12-byte random nonces, 4-byte zero sentinel, and 32-byte trailing HMAC-SHA256.
  - Implemented [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go#L183-L207) with lazy initialization on `Read`, header/version validation, chunk decryption, truncation detection, and trailing HMAC verification.
  - Implemented [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go#L309-L317), [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go#L319-L372), and [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/encryption/encryption.go#L374-L416) supporting `env`, `file`, `literal`, and `derive` key sources.
- **[config/job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/config/job.go)**: Added `Encryption` field, [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/config/job.go#L136-L138), and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/config/job.go#L113-L130).
- **[fileutil/filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/fileutil/filenutil.go)**: Updated [`EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L48) and [`EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/fileutil/filenutil.go#L50-L53) with `shouldEncrypt` to idempotently append `.enc` after `.gz`.
- **[handler/jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/handler/jobhandler.go)**: Updated [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/handler/jobhandler.go#L31-L65) and [`JobHandler.save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0di_buk7/handler/jobhandler.go#L68-L154) to fail fast on key loading/validation and stream gzipped output through `EncryptWriter`.
